answer: WITH t AS (SELECT c.Segment s, c.CustomerID id, SUM(y.Consumption) tot FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND y.Date LIKE '2013%' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID), m AS (SELECT s, tot, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s ORDER BY tot, id) rn FROM t), p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN s='SME' THEN tot END) sme, MAX(CASE WHEN s='LAM' THEN tot END) lam, MAX(CASE WHEN s='KAM' THEN tot END) kam FROM m WHERE rn=1) SELECT ROUND(sme-lam,2), ROUND(lam-kam,2), ROUND(kam-sme,2) FROM p

SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption END), 4) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Price = 634.8 AND Date = '2012-08-25')

SELECT CAST(ROUND((julianday(MAX(t.Date||' '||t.Time)) - julianday(MIN(t.Date||' '||t.Time))) * 1440, 3) AS INTEGER) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON g.GasStationID=t.GasStationID WHERE g.Country='CZE' AND t.Price>1000
note: float gives 3669.99999; true value 3670 minutes, so rounded before truncation
